_meta.name: Omega Mortgage Group Instagram Template
_meta.usage: Per-brand archetype contract. Editorial/premium look: serif display headlines + italic/script accent, navy #005181 dominant, near-white breathing room, real warm diverse family photography. Distinct from IEC (no red, hollow navy rings not filled, gold reserved for reviews).

color_roles.#005181: PRIMARY — dominant on every post: header pills, CTA bars, full backgrounds, numbered-circle RINGS, hero numerals.
color_roles.#FEFEFE: Near-white default light background, card fills, listicle backgrounds, breathing room.
color_roles.#FDD314: Gold — RESERVED for 5-star review graphics ONLY. Never a primary field on standard feed posts.
color_roles.#231F20: Near-black, dark text on light backgrounds.
color_roles.#FFFFFF: White headlines/body over navy or photo.

FORBIDDEN: filled navy circles with white numerals (that's IEC/CSC — Omega rings are HOLLOW)
gold as a primary field on a non-review post

BRAND.name: Omega Mortgage Group
BRAND.voice: Warm senior loan officer guiding a first-time buyer with patience. Educational, reassuring, partnering — never pushy, never hard-sell. 'Let's figure this out together.'
BRAND.tagline_feel: Wealth-management newsletter meets hometown realtor (NOT fintech startup).
BRAND.logo_usage: NEVER bake the Ω logo or OMEGA/MORTGAGE/GROUP wordmark into the image. Added separately after delivery.

FORBIDDEN_TEXT._rule: NEVER render any of these in the image — compliance/NMLS/license text is added ONLY by the dashboard Footer Overlay after delivery (brands.compliance). Unlike the old reference slides (which burned a compliance footer into the image), the new designs must NOT bake any of it in.

TYPOGRAPHY.display_serif: Elegant high-contrast serif (Playfair Display / Cormorant), mixed-case — hero numerals + topic headlines. THE signature.
TYPOGRAPHY.accent: Italic/script accent for connecting words ('Why', 'On Your Mortgage') paired with the serif. Most distinctive element — preserve it.
TYPOGRAPHY.eyebrow: Light sans ALL-CAPS with wide letter-spacing — category labels ('WAYS TO SAVE', 'WHY REFINANCE?').

A_photo_hero_navy_pill.description: Aspirational dream-home hero. Real warm photo on the top ~56%; cream text panel below with a small navy pill eyebrow, serif headline + SCRIPT accent, and a one-sentence body + soft CTA. Editorial and calm.
A_photo_hero_navy_pill.when_to_use: PRIMARY / DEFAULT archetype — Omega is photo-forward, so MOST posts use this. Reach for the text archetypes (C/D/G) only for genuine lists, stats, or reviews.
A_photo_hero_navy_pill._photos: Use real warm, diverse family/home photography. Approved assets exist (couple-keys, home-interior, neighborhood, elderly-couple, closing-table, sold-sign); otherwise generate warm golden-hour family/home scenes — never stock-cheese or fintech illustration.

C_numbered_listicle.description: The Omega workhorse. Near-white background. Navy pill eyebrow, serif headline with an italic accent word, then short numbered list items each preceded by a HOLLOW thin-ring navy circle with a navy numeral inside (never filled).
C_numbered_listicle.when_to_use: Tips, ways-to-save, requirements, step-by-step buyer education

D_big_number_hero.description: Giant serif (Playfair) numeral as the focal point on navy, with a serif topic line and short body. Editorial stat post.

G_testimonial_review.description: Customer review. Navy or near-white field, a row of 5 GOLD stars (the one place gold is used), italic-serif customer quote, light attribution. Calm and premium.

REUSABLE_ELEMENTS.eyebrow_pill: small navy #005181 rounded pill, white ALL-CAPS wide-tracked label ('WAYS TO SAVE')
REUSABLE_ELEMENTS.hollow_ring: thin-ring navy #005181 circle (HOLLOW, ~3px stroke) with a navy numeral centered inside — for numbered lists
REUSABLE_ELEMENTS.star_row: row of 5 GOLD #FDD314 stars — REVIEW posts only
REUSABLE_ELEMENTS.headline: serif display + 1 italic accent word, navy on light / white on navy

GLOBAL_HARD_RULES: Navy #005181 is dominant on every post.
Headlines are an ELEGANT SERIF (mixed-case) with ONE italic/script accent word — this serif+accent pairing is the signature; never all-caps bold-sans shouting.
Numbered lists use HOLLOW thin-ring navy circles with navy numerals — NEVER filled circles with white numerals.
Gold #FDD314 is ONLY for 5-star review graphics — never a primary fill on a normal feed post.
NO red anywhere (red is IEC, not Omega).

Photography: real, warm, inclusive families in real homes (interracial couples, families, multi-generation, elderly). Golden-hour / window light, cream interiors. NEVER stock-cheesy or fintech-flat illustration, never luxury fantasy.

DO NOT bake the logo, the OMEGA / MORTGAGE / GROUP wordmark, NMLS numbers, or any compliance/disclaimer text into the image — those are added after delivery. Leave the bottom ~10-12% as a calm quiet zone for the compliance overlay.
No hard-sell: never 'APPLY NOW', 'LIMITED TIME', 'instant approval'. Partnering, educational tone.
FULL-BLEED: the design fills the canvas edge-to-edge; no outer border/frame/rounded-corners/floating card.
Render every word crisply and correctly spelled.
GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_PROMPT: logo, wordmark, OMEGA MORTGAGE GROUP text, NMLS, MLS, NMLS number, license number, lic #, DFPI, DBO, Infinity Equity Group, nmlsconsumeraccess.org, state license codes, compliance band, footer disclosure band, disclaimer text, red, filled numbered circles with white numerals, bright primary colors, rainbow gradients, gold as a background, fintech flat illustration, stock-photo cheese, emoji, luxury mansion fantasy, all-caps bold-sans shouting, border, outer frame, rounded outer corners, drop shadow, floating card, APPLY NOW, LIMITED TIME, misspelled or garbled text
